system.description:
ALTERATION INVESTED

Usage any weapon; Requirement wielder has at least one ability with the Focus trait

This rune steadies the wielder's concentration and supports precise recovery between techniques.

You gain an item bonus to Refocus (Mental Focus) checks based upon the level of the rune.

CENTRED I

Level 3; Price 350 gp

The bonus is +1.

On the sheet: Applied automatically while the weapon is wielded: the item bonus is pre-ticked on every Refocus. It does not stack with armour's Centred (both are item bonuses).
